comingLast.roast: level pegging with Grant - the countback rules are being googled at the bar
current pace 1.4 a hole - the engraver is hovering
level with Pieper at the wrong end - the tension is real and hilarious
level with Pieper at the bottom - the blue balls may need a countback
in on 1 above the drop - his shout if he survives, tradition says
in with a 3-point moat - drawbridge stuck halfway up
in the clubhouse 3 clear - his card is safe, his pride pending
finished 3 clear of the blue balls - now buying Pieper drinks out of gratitude
in the clubhouse 4 above Pieper - cheering for him from a safe distance
